source.note: The shape is the page's "As a regular user" list response for GET /users?username=:username (id, username, name, state, web_url); the values are this corpus's own obviously fake reviewer, and the members the adapter never reads are removed. The page also states "Username search is case-insensitive", which is why the adapter re-checks the match itself.

The page does not publish the response for a username nobody has; an empty array is inferred from the endpoint being a filtered list rather than a lookup. The adapter answers null for it, which is the case reviewer routing depends on — a CODEOWNERS file naming somebody who has left is the ordinary state of a real repository.
